outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes, but no individual data points (N=4, n>100) are overlaid on the bars.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (N=4, n>400), but individual data points are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot, not a plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod vs. week) with error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E consists of line plots (time on rotarod across days at different weeks); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G shows only micrographs (immunofluorescence images), not a plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and number of Purkinje cells) showing mean ± SD (N=3, n=9), but no individual data points are overlaid.
